BTTS (Both Teams to Score) / GG (Goal Goal) Betting Predictions

BTTS (Both Teams to Score), also called GG (Goal Goal) means that both teams in a match must score at least one goal each for the bet to win. 

It doesn’t matter which team wins the match or what the final score is, what matters is that both teams find the back of the net.

Let’s say you place a BTTS bet on the match between Chelsea vs. Arsenal

If the match ends 2-1, 1-1, 3-2, or 4-3, your GG bet wins because both teams scored at least one goal.

And if the match ends 1-0, 0-0, or 3-0, your bet loses because one team failed to score.

BTTS betting is a great option because you don’t have to predict which team will win, just that both will score. This makes it a favorite among many bettors who follow football betting tips.

What Is Both Teams To Score (BTTS) Betting Strategy?

The Both Teams to Score (BTTS) betting strategy is straightforward. It’s based on predicting that both the home team and the away team will score at least one goal during the full-time of the match (90 minutes). 

This means you are betting that the game won’t end with one team failing to score. If both teams score, you win the bet. 

It’s one of the easiest strategies to follow in football betting, and it has gained popularity because of its simplicity and the excitement it brings to the game.

What Is Both Teams To Score In At Least One Half?

Both Teams to Score in at Least One Half is a bet where you predict that both teams will score at least one goal in either the first half or the second half of the match. 

For example, if the home team scores in the first half and the away team scores in the second half, your bet is successful. 

This is a good bet to consider when you think both teams are likely to score, but you’re not certain if they will score in the entire match.
